# SQLite Public Domain License

SQLite is in the [public domain](https://sqlite.org/copyright.html). The
authors disclaim copyright to the source code distributed in this directory.
In place of a legal notice, the amalgamation carries the following blessing:

> May you do good and not evil.
> May you find forgiveness for yourself and forgive others.
> May you share freely, never taking more than you give.

The files here are the unmodified SQLite amalgamation distribution
(`sqlite3.c`, `sqlite3.h`, `sqlite3ext.h`) for the version pinned in
[`README.md`](README.md). Provenance and integrity digests are recorded in
[`../../dependencies.lock.json`](../../dependencies.lock.json); Mira never
patches these files locally. If a change is required, the change is reported
upstream and the pinned archive is replaced as a whole with a new recorded
digest.
